facts.text: Introduce the shared survival job: find a spot for a shelter and coordinate with the other player.
Ask Alpha to consult Spamuel 1 and gather one material they need.
Ask Spamuel 1 what he personally did and what Alpha accomplished.
Interrupt Alpha with a new meeting place
Ask Spamuel 1 to check the shelter site and describe actual progress.
Ask Alpha about the shared build and which player did each part.
